line.name: E.P. Carrillo Interlude Natural
line.background_text: Debuted alongside the Maduro at the 2016 IPCPR trade show as part of the Dimension Series. Pairs an Ecuadorian Connecticut-seed wrapper with Nicaraguan long-filler, handmade at Tabacalera La Alianza, same two compact vitolas as the Maduro.

vitolas.summary_review: Dry, mild-to-medium with bread/cereal notes and a chalky, mineral finish; scored 85 by Cigar Aficionado's Cigar Insider.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Tawny cover leaf, dry smoke with bread and cereal before chalky mineral finish; ~$3.00.

vitolas.summary_review: Medium-strength short smoke; rated 86% by a retailer.

research_notes: Confirmed real. Binder origin disputed between sources (Nicaraguan per 2016/2018 press vs. Ecuadorian per current retail copy) - could reflect an actual blend change or inconsistent retailer copy, flagged rather than resolved. Maduro and Natural are separate blends, not wrapper variants of one recipe.

research_sources.supports: score, tasting notes, price, review date
